<h1 id="intro-title">Kamran Arora</h1>
<p class="role">Maths PhD student at the University of Bath, supervised by Federico Cornalba and Tony Shardlow. Previously, MMathPhys in Maths and Physics at the University of Warwick.</p>
<p class="positioning">I study problems at the interface between interacting particle systems and stochastic PDEs using tools from numerical and stochastic analysis. </p>
